component.name: DracoPho
component.summary: Wayland screenshot selection and annotation tool
Wayland 截图选区和标注工具

description.p: DracoPho captures screenshots, annotates image regions, pins floating image stickers, and provides OCR and translation helpers for pinned image text.
太殷龙摄支持截图选区、图像标注、置顶贴图，以及针对置顶图像文字的 OCR 与翻译辅助功能。

developer.name: Beijing Taiyin Zhaowu Technology Co., Ltd.

description.p: Feature release: brand update (DracoPho), timed/delayed capture with countdown, and live language switching for tray, floating ball and recording windows.

Maintenance release: Wayland-safe floating ball (edge docking disabled on native Wayland to remove ghost trails), honest hideOwnWindows toggle, headless recording CLI display-id normalization and argument validation, and a rebuilt 12-language feature comparison matrix.
Crash-safe recording (temp MKV + remux to faststart MP4), animated WebP output, unattended recording CLI, per-mode frame-rate persistence.
Configurable startup behavior (tray / floating ball / settings / direct capture) and a draggable floating ball.
Settings unsaved-changes reporting and multi-screen freeze fixes; localized README editions.
